import BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientCPGIC

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientCPGIC
open ProfileCollection ProfileModel ProfileSyntax QuotientModel DeepPositiveClosure

#print axioms equalityFree_strongTraceForm
#print axioms sat_strongTraceForm
#print axioms strongTrace_instance
#print axioms strong_trace
#print axioms literal_subset_representative
#print axioms interpreted_transitive
#print axioms quotient_containers
#print axioms rel_matrix_congr
#print axioms translated_instance
#print axioms quotient_collection
#print axioms quotient_fullGIC
#print axioms quotient_fullCPGIC
#print axioms quotient_modelsCPGIC

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

-- An actual native equality matrix produces an exact singleton object.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (w : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (t : Domain mem w h) :
    ∃ b, ∀ y, quotientMember mem w h y b ↔ y = t := by
  obtain ⟨a, hta, _, _⟩ := quotient_containers mem w h t
  obtain ⟨b, hs, hc⟩ := quotient_collection mem w h (.fEq 1 2) (fun _ => t) a
  have htSome : ∃ y, MatrixRelation (quotientMember mem w h) (.fEq 1 2)
      (fun _ => t) t y := ⟨t, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hvb, hvt⟩ := hc t hta htSome
  change v = t at hvt
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hs y hy
    exact hxy
  · intro hy
    simpa only [hy, hvt] using hvb

-- The actual false matrix supplies an empty quotient object.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (w : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∃ e, ∀ y, ¬ quotientMember mem w h y e := by
  obtain ⟨e, hs, _⟩ := quotient_collection mem w h .fBot
    (fun _ => mk mem w h w) (mk mem w h w)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs y hy
  exact hx

-- A quantified native-equality/parameter-collision matrix needs no EF premise.
example (mem : V → V → Prop) (w : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (env : Nat → Domain mem w h) :
    CollectionInstance (quotientMember mem w h)
      (MatrixRelation (quotientMember mem w h)
        (.fAll (.fImp (.fEq 0 2) (.fEq 2 3))) env) :=
  quotient_collection mem w h _ env

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientCPGIC
